paragraphs: R. Yefet, father of R. Binyamin, [who was] R. Yoḥanan's student. That is to say, R. Binyamin was R. Yoḥanan's student (see his entry). I do not know whether [Yefet] was a sage, for everywhere he mentions 'R. Binyamin bar Yefet,' and does not call him 'Rav' or 'R. Yefet.'
